genzel.said: Well, you see, at this point we really are fairly sure that there is a massive black hole at the center of our Milky Way. And the next thing we want to actually play with it, in the sense that we want to use it as a tool to test whether general relativity, the theory of Einstein, is actually wrong or right.
subs: Ab hum kaafi had tak pakka hain, ki hamari Milky Way ke centre mein ek massive black hole hai.
Aur ab hum uske saath khelna chahte hain.
Use ek tool ki tarah use karke dekhna, ki Einstein ki general relativity sahi hai ya galat.
genzel.credit: ESO (Reinhard Genzel talks about his research, video news release eso0846c, 2008)
